title: Encoding a list of segments
statement: Define the encoding of a list of segments recursively: the empty list encodes as the empty word, and a one-segment list encodes as the rendering of that segment. For a list with at least two segments, encode the first segment, append the separator $01$, and then encode the remaining list.
